title: Tomb of Prophet Zul Kifl (a)
introduction:
TOMB OF PROPHET ZUL KIFL (A)

Zulkifil Prophet (peace be upon him).He is Judah, the son of the Prophet Ishaq (peace be upon him) son of the Prophet Ibrahim Khalil Allah (peace be upon him). He is the his oldest sons and named Zulkifil because he asures his people to make them have enough to serve them, and judge between them with justice. His shrine is located in the village of Kifl in Iraq in the middle of the road between Kufa and Hilla on the eastern bank of the Euphrates-beside Al-Nakhlaa mosque. He visited by people from all religions.
